purpose: zero-training identifiability check for a physically exclusive full-team forecast commitment

decision.maintain_primary: all three roles remain on the primary service chain
decision.stage_full_team: all three roles commit to the public forecast sector; primary service is consequently not maintained during the lock

identifiability_requirement: Under matched exogenous branches, high reliability must favor full-team staging and low reliability must favor maintaining the primary chain with direction support and no global collapse.
boundary: This is a new task contract, not a re-interpretation of P8. It is only eligible for learning after the paired Q0 check passes.
